$comment: Coverage of the XCCDF 1.1.4 and 1.2 schemas by the benchmark path. Keys under paths are the XSD walker's prefix-free local-name paths (a key ending in /** covers the paths below it, never the path itself). Keys under vendor are paths the schemas leave opaque, extended with the publisher's own elements or narrowed with a [@attr=value] selector. target names where the value lands in the Baseline, or skip with a reason. Asserted by go/coverage_test.go and typescript/coverage.test.ts.

Benchmark/@Id.reason: the 1.2 XML Schema ID is a signature anchor, not an identifier the Baseline carries

Benchmark/@resolved.reason: resolution flag is not carried; the converter reads the file as published

Benchmark/Group.reason: walked as the Group root; each Group becomes a group and its rules requirements

Benchmark/Platform-Specification.reason: 1.1.4 platform definitions from imported namespaces are not carried

Benchmark/Profile.reason: one entry per Profile: id, title and selectedRuleIds

Benchmark/Profile/@Id.reason: profile @Id is not carried; a profile entry is its id, title and selected ids
